title: Phase 1: Analysis
use_cases: Use when breaking down a long-form screenplay into manageable batches
Implement when detailed scene metadata like subtext and camera angles are required
Configure when setting up an LLM persona for narrative analysis
Use when mapping story beats before generating final script text
content:
Now we get to work. We split the screenplay into atomic units (scenes) and batch them into chunks. But we aren’t writing yet.

- The Output: We don’t want new text; we want metadata. For every scene, we generate a JSON object containing a beat summary, the emotional subtext, the camera suggestions, and “pitfalls” (clichés to avoid). We are essentially building a detailed map of the territory before we start driving.
- The Persona: We tell the LLM to act as a “Legendary Film Director”.
